core_idea: The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice Heathcliff is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Tremor — Scorch** — on Tremor Burst the target takes **Wrath** damage equal to **(Burn Potency + Tremor Potency) / 2**, so it needs a Burn stacker alongside it. Like all Tremor, its **Tremor Burst** also raises the target's **Stagger Threshold** by its Potency. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Tremor) (max +2); +10% damage per Maturing Textbook Stack (max +30%). Support passive (**In One-on-one Duels…**) applies when allies **land hits**.
playstyle_guide:
- **In One-on-one Duels…** triggers **On Hit** — allies need to attack for the passive to apply.
- Skills check **3+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- **Burst** when you're ready to break the stagger target.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Tremor) (max +2).
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — La Spada di Palermo** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Tremor)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Tremor) on target (max 2)

**S2 — Colpi Sottani** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Tremor)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Tremor) on target (max 2); [Clash Win] If target has The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff), inflict +1 Tremor Count

**S3 — Il Cacciatore** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Tremor)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Up to **+30% damage** (+10% per **Maturing Textbook Stack**) — stack the resource before committing.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- triggers Amplitude Conversion, converting the target's Tremor to this kit's subtype
- Inflict 2 Burn and +2 Burn Count
- Inflict 2 Tremor and +2 Tremor Count

*↳ Alternate S3 — Sezionatura di Cervo* (BP 5, CP +3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
  - Gain +(Maturing Textbook - 1) Atk Weight (max 2)
  - Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Tremor) on the main target (max 3)
  - When attacking just 1 target, deal +25% damage (for Focused Encounters, 1 Part)
  - Deal +25% damage for every excess Atk Weight beyond the # of actual targets (for Focused Encounters, Parts)
  - Consume all The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on the main target

Combat passive — **Duello Disperato**: At Base Skill End against an enemy:.
  - If the target is defeated while having The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) (on any of its Parts), gain 1 Maturing Textbook.
  - If the main target isn't defeated, inflict 1 The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on the main target.

Combat passive — **Palermitan Style**: Gain the following effects based on (Maturing Textbook on self + The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on the main target).
  - Base Skills deal +3% damage for every combined Stack (max 15%).
  - 1+ Stack: Clash Power +1.

Defense skill — **Counter: Measuring Blade Reach**: [Clashable Counter].
  - Deal +20% damage for every The Duel Escalates (Heathcliff) on target (max 100%).
  - [On Use] Final Power +1 for every 4 (Burn + Tremor) on target (max 2).
